 Beyond the Storm: Assessing FEMA’s Mission Readiness
 November 19 – 10:00 am - 1:00 pm 
 DETAILS: 
 What:  A Subcommittee on Emergency Management and Technology hearing entitled, “Beyond the Storm: Assessing FEMA’s Mission Readiness.”
 When:  Thursday, November 19, 2026, at 10:00 AM ET
 Where:  310 Cannon House Office Building
 WITNESS: 
 The Honorable Cameron Hamilton 
Administrator, Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA)
 Witness testimony can be found here . The hearing will be livestreamed on YouTube and will be open to the public and press. Press must be congressionally credentialed and should RSVP in advance.
